note: G gates: limits written before the first harness run and never changed since (only the detector name in the path was updated when the Fitts-only detector was redesigned in iteration 2). The three G3 gates were blocking until iteration 2 showed they cannot be met at 25 clicks on this narrow-difficulty task; they are kept, unchanged, as OPEN targets that the next iterations work toward. R gates: regression floors added after iteration 2, set below the level then achieved, so later work cannot silently lose it.
